items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Oh, he started here with my big band.

ctx.x: Ferdinand, I thought I had. But it's spelled F-U-R-N-E-N-D, Fernand. He wanted to make the distinction between the Ferdinand and Fernand.
I think we just about got the rhythm there except, well, Ferdinand and Dajon.
